title: Exotic Sweet Mexican Fig Skewers
description: A romantic Mexican dish featuring sweet figs and a hint of wine, perfect for a special occasion, this recipe is also buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not include any animal products or by-products
instructions: Soak the bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes before using to prevent burning on the robata grill.
In a large bowl, whisk together the red wine, brown sugar, lime juice, and olive oil to create the marinade.
Add the ground cinnamon sticks to the marinade and stir well.
Thread a fig onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space between each fig.
Place the fig skewers in the marinade and let them sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the fig skewers from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Place the fig skewers on the robata grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the figs are caramelized and slightly charred.
Remove the fig skewers from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
